descriptions.text: Wisp Armor. Cost: 5 Mana. Target: Self Only. Duration: 5 minutes + 1 minute per level of spell. Requires 5 minute cooldown. Surrounds your body with tendrils of light. While ineffective against physical attacks, this spell negates 75% of incoming damage from magic-based attacks. Provides temporary immunity to mind-control effects. Higher skill levels increase both effectiveness and duration. It also makes you look all wispy and ethereal and druid-like. A great spell to have if you're a club kid or trying to bang a vegan.

beats.headline: Five mana, and he has three
beats.text: Carl's Bronze Boss Box, fifth of seven, gives him a Tome of Wisp Armor. It's a good find, Mordecai says, but it costs five mana to cast and Carl has three. Hold onto it until you decide what your build is going to be; it's quite valuable. Or give it to the princess. I'll take it, says Donut, who doesn't even know what it is yet. Carl reads the spell's description. A magic protection spell. That would be useful. He holds onto it for now.

beats.headline: Top of the list
beats.text: A Skill Potion from Carl's gold Looter Box adds a level to Determine Value. It does not tell him what anything is worth, but it lets him sort his inventory by value, and he does. The first item on the list is the Tome of Wisp Armor. The second is the Chopper. The list leaves out what he has equipped; he suspects his troll skin shirt would top it otherwise.

beats.headline: Enough intelligence, not yet
beats.text: With his stats settled, Carl has given himself enough Intelligence to read the Wisp Armor spellbook, and he doesn't do it quite yet. He is still on the fence about using it himself, giving it to Donut or selling it, and he wants to see what its actual monetary value is first.

beats.headline: Read on the way to an ogre
beats.text: Carl has held the tome to sell. Donut asks for it about once a day, and he has nearly relented, but he is meant to be the party's tank. Now there is no time to wait. Walking down the bleachers toward Apollon, the ice-cream-selling strongman, he activates the tome, puts Wisp Armor on his hotlist and drinks a mana regen potion to reach five points. Apollon hands him a cone of worms, compliments of Grimaldi. Carl casts the spell, sparkling lights twirling round him like comets, and swallows. When the parasite pulls at his mind, the armor leaves him his own for the next five minutes.
